# Evidence Stack

Component ID: evidence-stack

## Narrative intent

让主张、数值和来源同时可见，使观众能判断证据是否真的支持结论。

Select this recipe only when the current story event needs that audience outcome; the animation alone is not evidence that the outcome was delivered.

## Purpose and selection

- Attach one measured figure and its source to one bounded claim.

Do not use:

- Do not fabricate a source, imply statistical significance or use an unsupported metric as proof.

## Supported inputs

- title: Supply real claim within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
- stat: One measured figure with unit/denominator when needed; do not fabricate or remove uncertainty.
- evidence: Describe the sample, scope and important qualifier without broadening the claim.
- source: A real source attribution whose reference can be checked in the storyboard; do not claim statistical confidence.

## Reading order and motion

- Read the claim
- Read the measured figure
- Read its scope and source
- Hold claim and evidence together

Pattern: progressive-build. Native default duration: 8s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### metric

- Target: .stat
- Visible action: Reveal the measured figure
- Authored start: 1.2s; action duration: 0.65s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal the measured figure. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### scope

- Target: .evidence
- Visible action: Explain the evidence scope
- Authored start: 3.1s; action duration: 0.6s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Explain the evidence scope. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### source

- Target: .source
- Visible action: Attach its actual source
- Authored start: 5s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Attach its actual source. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### resolve

- Target: .card:not(.back)
- Visible action: Settle claim and evidence together
- Authored start: 6.6s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

These are authored event defaults, not measured speech alignment. Rebind active events to actual narration at project FPS; omitted capacity items must not acquire phantom cues. Preserve source easing, internal timing ratios and landing geometry. Source implementation is authoritative for curves not declared in the manifest; this card does not invent calibrated parameter ranges.

## Sequence and adjacent handoff

Choose the sequence by the audience task using the Video Studio Sequence templates, then verify this card's use/avoid rules for its assigned slot. Sequence membership is not proof of fit or a new rendering capability.

- Entry reading state: Read the claim
- Landing reading state: Hold claim and evidence together
- Handoff: identify the outgoing result and next subject in the existing storyboard narrative. Preserve only labels, comparison anchors or direction actually supported by the paired recipes. Use a direct cut when the semantic connection is enough; unsupported object morphs/camera paths require a different pairing or a disclosed gap.
- Budget: reserve readable Land time first; an incoming transition lives inside the next shot's Establish window. Do not duplicate narration or reset a developed object merely to replay an entrance.

## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
- missingInput: Report missing source/evidence or present a clearly qualified statement; never fabricate a metric or citation.
- timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
- inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.

- Read the claim → Read the measured figure → Read its scope and source → Hold claim and evidence together. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
- Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
